NONE: › a friendly way of talking to a man

example: Look here, my boy, this simply won't do.

NONE: › said when you do not believe what someone has just said

example: "She said she had food poisoning." "Food poisoning, my arse! She just drank too much last night."
「她說她食物中毒了。」「食物中毒？胡說！她昨晚只是喝多了。」

NONE: › US informal used for saying that you accept that you are wrong or that something is your fault
› used to mean that you do not believe what another person has just told you
（表示不相信對方所說的話）算了吧

example: "He says his car isn't working." "Not working my foot. He's just too lazy to come."
「他說他的車壞了。」「鬼才相信他的話。他不過是太懶了，不想來。」

NONE: › used to say that you feel great sadness for someone. This phrase is often used humorously to mean the opposite.
我的心爲（某人）流血，我爲（某人）感到悲傷（幽默的用法，常表示相反的意思）

example: humorous John complains he only has two cars - my heart bleeds for him (= I certainly do not feel sadness about that)!
約翰抱怨自己只有兩輛汽車——我真爲他感到悲哀！

NONE: › said when you are promising to keep a secret

example: "Oh and please don't tell him you saw me here." "Don't worry. My lips are sealed."
「哦，請別告訴他你在這裡見過我。」「放心吧，我會守口如瓶的。」

NONE: › said in answer to something that someone has just said when you believe it yourself, or when you have said it yourself earlier

example: "So even if we got the funding, we still couldn't get the project started." "My point exactly."
「那麼即使我們得到了那筆資金，也仍然無法開始專案。」「我就是那意思。」

NONE: › a way of talking to someone you love
